criteria.requirement: With no explicit HEAD route, Bottle falls back to GET and executes the callback again, then suppresses response body bytes while retaining GET-derived Content-Length. An empty HEAD body does not imply the callback was skipped. Keep GET/HEAD callbacks free of business mutations and use an explicitly authorized mutating method with application validation for writes.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.
